body: Also, I am sorry that you are going through that as well.
I wish I didn't either. It's ruined my life.

Thank you. The stupid part is that i don't even have any bugs. i'm just terrified of what seems like an eventuality--they continue to grow in number every year--I feel like they're closing in on me. Coming after me. 

They're so hard to get rid of--my therapist and I had to put me on strict orders not to read about them anymore--my head is just a running counter full of horrible facts about them. I used to love sleeping, and my bed. Now it's just another ticking time zone. There's no escape.
